info.title: Glasswork.Preview: real Dear ImGui rendered headless to PNG, with scripted input.
info.description: Renders the real toolkit through real Dear ImGui to PNG without the game, with scripted input, and compares a plugin's preview screens with their goldens in its own CI. Loads Dalamud's ImGui bindings from the developer's Dalamud folder at run time.

options.name: --scene
options.description: what to draw, one of imgui, glass, widgets, widgets-states, surface, shell, gallery, charts, data, inspector, effects-ambient, effects-loaders, effects-particles, effects-motion, game-kit, game-kit-world, theme-designer, theme-designer-shape, theme-designer-glass, theme-designer-audit, theme-designer-accent, theme-designer-library, forms, productivity, showcase-hero, showcase-looks, showcase-looks-new, showcase-glass, showcase-dashboard, showcase-effects, showcase-game-kit, showcase-forms, showcase-palette, showcase-reorder, showcase-designer, showcase-first-window (required unless --selftest or --compare)

options.name: --out
options.description: where to save the last frame (default: <scene>.png); with --compare, the directory for the actuals and diffs

options.name: --size
options.description: display size in pixels (default: 1280x800)

options.name: --frames
options.description: frames to run before saving (default: 3; a script extends it)

options.name: --backdrop
options.description: an image behind the scene instead of the procedural one

options.name: --warp
options.description: render on the WARP software rasterizer

options.name: --adapter
options.description: render on that DXGI adapter, an index from --list-adapters or a part of its name, instead of the default one

options.name: --script
options.description: frame-numbered input lines: move, click, down, up, wheel, key, text, shot

options.name: --look
options.description: the Look the widget scenes draw with, one of neutral, liquid, eorzea, minimal, high-contrast, retro, classic, clear-blue, clear-grey, clear-green, clear-pink, aurora, catppuccin, nord (default: neutral)

options.name: --light
options.description: draw the widget scenes in the light variant of the Look

options.name: --reduce-motion
options.description: draw the widget scenes with reduced motion: springs snap, the glass light stays still

options.name: --contrast
options.description: draw the widget scenes with increased contrast and reduced transparency: opaque fills with borders, no translucent surface

options.name: --scale
options.description:
the UI scale the showcase scenes draw at, 0.5 to 4 (default: 1); --size stays in pixels, and the
scenes rasterise Segoe UI, Consolas and the icon font at every size they draw at that scale

options.name: --font
options.description: the face the widget scenes draw with (default: the system's Segoe UI when present)

options.name: --icon-font
options.description: the icon glyphs merged into that face (default: Dalamud's FontAwesome asset when present)

options.name: --deterministic
options.description: hide what varies between runs, such as GPU timings, so the frame can be compared with a golden

options.name: --no-shared-captures
options.description: give every glass draw outside a group its own capture instead of sharing one among consecutive draws

options.name: --record
options.description: save the run as an animated PNG: every frame from --record-from to --record-to, sampled at --record-fps

options.name: --record-from
options.description: the first frame recorded (default: 1)

options.name: --record-to
options.description: the last frame recorded (default: the run's last frame; a larger frame extends the run)

options.name: --record-fps
options.description: the recording's frame rate, 1 to 60; the run simulates 60 frames per second and keeps one in every 60/n (default: 20)

options.name: --selftest
options.description: prove the renderer and the draw-callback path; exits 0 when correct

options.name: --compare
options.description:
render the fixed scene list on WARP, one process per scene, with ImGui's default font unless --font
and --icon-font say otherwise, and compare each PNG with <dir>/<name>.png; exits 1 on any mismatch

options.name: --tolerance
options.description: with --compare: a channel may differ by this much out of 255 before its pixel counts (default: 2)

options.name: --max-diff
options.description: with --compare: the fraction of differing pixels a scene may have and still pass (default: 0.001)

options.name: --update
options.description: with --compare: write the renders into <dir> as the new goldens instead of comparing

options.name: --list-adapters
options.description: print the DXGI adapters (index, name, dedicated video memory, hardware or software, driver version) and exit

options.name: --assembly
options.description:
a plugin's preview assembly instead of the built-in scenes: --scene names one of its IPreviewScreen
screens (without --scene the screens are listed), --compare and --update render every one of them;
a screen brings its own size, Look and script, so --size, --look, --light, --reduce-motion,
--contrast and --script do not apply

options.name: --dalamud
options.description:
the folder holding Dalamud.Bindings.ImGui.dll, HexaGen.Runtime.dll and cimgui.dll, which the tool
loads at run time (default: DALAMUD_HOME, then %APPDATA%\XIVLauncher\addon\Hooks\dev)
